Workflow.Name: BN 2 - Deliver Briefing Note
Workflow.Description: Starts when a briefing request is Approved: renders the final PDF with its classification marking, files it in SharePoint, emails it with a prebuilt cover message and posts in Teams to the requester and the ultimate recipient.
